description: Mistral AI's 4.4B multilingual realtime speech-to-text model on one DGX Spark, served by vLLM 0.32.0 as the vLLM Voxtral Realtime recipe documents (`--tokenizer-mode mistral`, piecewise CUDA graphs, 131,072-token window, about three hours of audio). vLLM mounts the OpenAI transcription route, POST /v1/audio/transcriptions, which the Vonk API facts and smoke use, and also the streaming WebSocket route /v1/realtime for live audio; the Realtime route is not yet a typed Vonk interface. 13 languages, any transcription delay from 80 ms to 2.4 s set in the model's tekken.json (480 ms default). Uploads are limited by vLLM's defaults of 25 MiB and 600 seconds. Memory follows the creator, who sets no utilization: vLLM's default 0.9 applies, and the declared peak of 123.8 GB is the offline estimate for it (admissible on an idle Spark); it is an estimate until tried.
title: Voxtral Mini 4B Realtime 2602 (vLLM, single Spark)
